pages.title: THE TIMELINE IS DEAD
pages.subtitle: Why Video Production Is Moving from Mouse Clicks to Deterministic Code

pages.title: 01 // THE GRAPHICAL USER INTERFACE TRAP
pages.content:
Traditional video editing software was built for humans with mice. Dragging clips on a timeline works for one video. It fails for ten thousand videos. You cannot automate a GUI button.

A human editor sits in a chair, drags clips 12 pixels left, tweaks color grading, and exports. Total time: 4 hours for 1 video. Video-as-Code turns pixels into pure functions.

pages.title: 02 // DECLARATIVE VIDEO AS CODE
pages.content:
Frame 0 is a state object. Frame 60 is a CSS transform. Frame 120 is an audio node. You don't edit pixels; you declare rules.

Remotion turns React components into video frames. TypeScript guarantees your props are valid. Headless Chrome renders each frame inside a controlled Virtual Time environment.

pages.title: 03 // VIRTUAL TIME & 60 FPS DETERMINISM
pages.content: React code + Headless Chrome + Virtual Time = 100% reproducible video frames without wall-clock lag. Every render produces 100% identical pixels with 0% silent drift.
